distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Yunnan and Taiwan; Yunnan locality detail includes Xishuangbanna. Beaver & Liu (2010) also recognizes Taiwan occurrence but explicitly questions whether the species is permanently established there. Because later reviewed evidence continues to record Taiwan occurrence, Taiwan remains Present; the establishment caveat is retained separately and is not treated as a doubtful historical occurrence.

host_note: No host is reported in the promoted Smith et al. (2020) record. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species as strongly polyphagous, but this broad source statement is retained as source-level context and does not create a current host record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus morigerus (Blandford, 1894).
